summary: monday.com Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, attaching a press release announcing its first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing reports revenue of $351.3 million (24% YoY growth), GAAP operating income of $19.8 million, and non-GAAP operating income of $49.0 million. It highlights customer metrics, including a 74% increase in customers with over $500k ARR, and the launch of an AI Work Platform. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender, or restructuring is present. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer. The filing does not involve any deal terms or structural changes to the company.
